flows.description: register [code: Registration request reaches POST /api/auth/register as multipart form data with an uploaded file field named profileImage.]

enrichment.note: Registration request reaches POST /api/auth/register as multipart form data with an uploaded file field named profileImage.

flows.description: store account [code: New account record is written to the users collection during the register flow.]

enrichment.note: New account record is written to the users collection during the register flow.

flows.description: JWT + data [code: Login/auth session data returned to the browser is subsequently persisted under localStorage keys token and user.]

enrichment.note: Login/auth session data returned to the browser is subsequently persisted under localStorage keys token and user.

flows.description: child login [code: Child login is a POST to /api/auth/login/child that triggers reads from both the users collection and the childprofiles collection.]

enrichment.note: Child login is a POST to /api/auth/login/child that triggers reads from both the users collection and the childprofiles collection.

flows.description: JWT + profiles [code: Child login response data persisted in the browser includes a token plus a serialized user object in localStorage keys token and user.]

enrichment.note: Child login response data persisted in the browser includes a token plus a serialized user object in localStorage keys token and user.

flows.description: create child profile [code: Create-child-profile request is sent to POST /api/subprofiles as multipart form data with uploaded file field idImage.]

enrichment.note: Create-child-profile request is sent to POST /api/subprofiles as multipart form data with uploaded file field idImage.

flows.description: store profile [code: A child profile record is saved to the childprofiles collection during child-profile creation.]

enrichment.note: A child profile record is saved to the childprofiles collection during child-profile creation.

flows.description: search / watch / like [code: Child-driven child-profile updates include request-video, search-history, and watch-history POSTs under /api/subprofiles; these cause reads of video records and/or child profile records.]

enrichment.note: Child-driven child-profile updates include request-video, search-history, and watch-history POSTs under /api/subprofiles; these cause reads of video records and/or child profile records.

flows.description: video metadata + files [code: Video data written by the service includes uploaded multipart file field video to backend/uploads plus a saved record in the videos collection; later updates also save video documents.]

enrichment.note: Video data written by the service includes uploaded multipart file field video to backend/uploads plus a saved record in the videos collection; later updates also save video documents.

flows.description: watch history [code: Watch-history updates are stored by saving the child's profile document in the childprofiles collection after the /api/subprofiles/watch-history request.]

enrichment.note: Watch-history updates are stored by saving the child's profile document in the childprofiles collection after the /api/subprofiles/watch-history request.

flows.description: upload video [code: Video upload request is POST /api/videos/upload with multipart file field video.]

enrichment.note: Video upload request is POST /api/videos/upload with multipart file field video.

flows.description: stream video [code: Video streaming is served from GET /api/videos/stream/:filename, with uploaded media exposed from the /uploads static mount backed by backend/uploads.]

enrichment.note: Video streaming is served from GET /api/videos/stream/:filename, with uploaded media exposed from the /uploads static mount backed by backend/uploads.

flows.description: govt ID image [code: Registration uploads an image file under form field profileImage, and the image-upload middleware writes it into backend/uploads/images.]

enrichment.note: Registration uploads an image file under form field profileImage, and the image-upload middleware writes it into backend/uploads/images.

flows.description: JWT in localStorage [code: Authentication state persisted in browser storage uses localStorage keys token and user; the API client later reads token from localStorage.]

enrichment.note: Authentication state persisted in browser storage uses localStorage keys token and user; the API client later reads token from localStorage.

flows.description: history to parent [code: Parent-facing child history retrieval is GET /api/subprofiles/{childId}/history and reads a child profile document from the childprofiles collection.]
flows.uncertainty_note: The DF17 label sits near overlapping arrows between Parent User, Authentication Service, and Child Profile Management. The arrowhead appears at Parent User, indicating flow from Child Profile Management to Parent User.

enrichment.note: Parent-facing child history retrieval is GET /api/subprofiles/{childId}/history and reads a child profile document from the childprofiles collection.
